messages:
maya: Cutoff in ~4h for release 0.8.2 — need to sync docs site deploy + SDK docs regen. Who's taking regen, who can own staging smoke? Please ping PRs.
jeff: I'll take Python SDK regen. Planning to open PR to update docs site snippets + versions. Will push a tag `v0.8.2` after CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/432
lucy: I can coordinate docs site deploy. Suggest deploy window at +3h (so we have 1h buffer). Can we freeze doc edits to main for the next 3h? I'll add a note on the docs repo.
sanjay: Changelog bump already in #456 — summary: list of fixes + version bump to 0.8.2. I pushed a tiny changelog entry; can someone confirm formatting? snippet:
```
## 0.8.2 — 2026-03-17
- console: fix route metrics in rollout UI
- runtime: reduce kv-cache mem in small batches
- docs: clarify SDK init options
```
elaine: I'll run smoke tests on staging once docs-bot posts the staging URL. Quick smoke commands I use:
```
curl -fsS https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/health || echo "docs down"
curl -sS https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/sdk/python/installation | grep "pip install"
```
omar: Heads up — the console rollout has a canary that references docs links. If we change paths, we need a redirect rule. Lucy, can you ensure 301s are set for /sdk/python -> /sdk/python/installation if needed?
lucy: Yep, will add redirect config in the deploy PR. Also, I'll tag the staging build with `staging/docs/0.8.2-preview` so smoke tests point to a fixed artifact.
docs-bot: staging build created: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/0.8.2 (created by lucy)
jeff: Python SDK regen PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/433 — includes docs snapshot and version bump in conf.py. CI green, need one review.
maya: @jeff @lucy @elaine can we get a quick thumbs on the regen PR + staging smoke by EOD? If both green, I'll approve and we can merge 2h before cutoff.
jeff: tagging @omar for the redirect confirmation.
omar: Redirects look good; tested locally with nginx config. Approving once it's in the deploy PR.
lucy: Deploy PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/789 — includes redirect, staging tag, and a tiny sitemap update. Requesting review from @docs-eng.
maya: Plan: 1) freeze docs edits 2) merge regen PR -> regenerate HTML snapshot 3) merge deploy PR to staging 4) smoke tests by @elaine 5) final merge to main and schedule production deploy 1h before cutoff. Anyone object?
jeff: 👍 no objections
elaine: 👍 will run smoke and post results here
deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled by lucy at 2167890600
elaine: smoke run @ 2167890700 -> health ok, pip snippet present, all links 200 except /sdk/python (redirected correctly)
maya: OK looks good. I'll merge the regen PR and tag the snapshot.
jeff: regen merged and tag pushed `v0.8.2-docs-snapshot` — artifact: s3://redwood-docs/previews/0.8.2
docs-bot: Preview published: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/0.8.2 (hash: abc123)
lucy: staging deploy to preview passed. Starting prod deploy in 20m unless any last-minute holds.
omar: confirmed redirect rules in prod config. No holds.
maya: locking docs/main for merge window now.
deploy-bot: Production deploy started at 2167891200 by lucy
jeff: SDK docs site updated on prod; python docs page links resolve. All good on my side :rocket:
elaine: final smoke on prod — health ok, samples render, changelog link present. ✅
maya: Thanks team — release 0.8.2 docs + SDK regen complete. Will post release notes and close the cutoff ticket.
